items.name: SIH26247-AERIS
items.description: AERIS — an offline-first AI-ready drone and counter-drone simulation trainer with degraded sensors, explainable scoring and after-action review.

items.name: SIH-26247-Counter-Drone-Threat-Simulation-Trainer
items.description: Software-based AI simulation platform to train defence personnel in recognizing, classifying, and responding to drone/swarm threats with zero hardware dependency (SIH 26247 - MoD/DSSC)

items.name: sih26247-trainer
items.description: The intended solution is a training/simulation platform where trainees can practice detecting, identifying, assessing and responding to simulated drone threats under different conditions. The implementation I found describes synthetic sensors, threat scenarios, sensor degradation, decision-making and after-action review.

items.name: AERIS-SIH26247-Axion_fc
items.description: AERIS is a laptop-first drone encounter training simulator for SIH 2026 (SIH26247). It provides repeatable synthetic scenarios, detection and classification practice, transparent decision scoring, and after-action review in browser and Windows WebView2 modes.

items.name: drone-sim-platform
items.description: Drone and swarm threat training simulator for SIH PS 26247 (Drone Defence): a browser 3D simulator with explainable decision-tree scoring and an after-action review dashboard. Runs offline; English and Hindi.

items.name: SUDARSHAN
items.description: Browser-based drone and counter-drone threat simulation trainer for unit-level training. Sensor-realistic scenarios, seeded procedural generation, explainable decision-tree scoring, adaptive difficulty and an after-action review dashboard. Built for SIH 2026 PS 26247 (MoD). Fictional scenarios, open data.
